records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The Company’s operating revenue increased by 36.6 percent in the second quarter of 2021 compared to the same period in 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increase resulted primarily from increases in revenue per shipment and tonnage.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The operating ratio (operating expenses divided by operating revenue) was 85.5 percent in the second quarter of 2021 compared to 91.5 percent in the second quarter of 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The improved operating ratio compared to prior year is due to the negative economic impact of COVID-19 in the prior year quarter, as well as the Company’s continued focus on pricing initiatives, cost control and operational efficiencies.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Consolidated operating income was $82.9 million for the second quarter of 2021 compared to $35.7 million for the second quarter of 2020.
